name: Number 19
source:
As you find yourself severely injured after a dangerous mission, search and rescue comes to your aid. A fellow hunter who calls himself #19 arrives at your location to patch your wounds and get you out of there. Will you let him help you?

[from [url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/number-19]itch.io[/url]]
